note: Batch g8 (2026-10-14). Groupings and directions by an agent from the claims' titles and evidence entries. Highlighting/underlining evidence and elaborative-annotation evidence are kept under separate questions on purpose: the page distinguishes marking from elaborative notes, and the wiki has no claim testing learner-written margin notes. The note-taking question (laptop vs longhand) is lecture note-taking, not text annotation; drop it if judged off-topic. Review before applying.

findings.question: Does asking learners to highlight or underline while reading improve learning over reading alone, and for which outcomes?
Does it matter what is marked, and who marks it (learner or instructor)?
Do annotations that make the reader generate questions, explanations or summaries improve comprehension?
Does the medium of the notes (handwritten or typed) change what is learned?
